walkthroughs.body_html:
Data Types & Structures — a core area of A-Level Computer Science.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Data Types & Structures brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Data Types & Structures.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

Any item, randomly.
Encrypting data so it cannot be read.

options: Only the root node.
